reviews.summary: It answers the search in the first line, then gives tiered ideas, a copy-ready note, a table that turns an overheard remark into a gift, and an honest line on the research: more usable tonight than the generic idea lists and quiz pages at the top. Polish only: plainer tense in one sample line, US/UK-neutral 'favourite'/'Apologise', a 'short on time' next step.

Every product, template, quiz and scheduling claim checked against the code and found true. Asked that the FAQ answer the 'What are the 7 gift categories?' PAA question outright (it was only hinted at), checking the list against a source and saying lists differ; same in Spanish.
